40020322.author: पदार्थः
40020322.content: राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, अभिषिक्तः having been crowned, तु but, भ्रातृभ्याम् with his two brothers, सहितः accompanied, तदा then, ततः thereafter, प्रदानम् the giving, राक्षस्याः of the Rakshasi, भगिन्याः of his sister, समचिन्तयत् thought about.

40020322.author: Translation
40020322.content: The lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, having been crowned and accompanied by his two brothers, then thought about giving his Rakshasi sister in marriage.

40020323.author: पदार्थः
40020323.content: स्वसारम् his sister, कालकेयाय to Kalakeya, दानवेन्द्राय to the lord of Danavas, राक्षसीम् the Rakshasi, ददौ he gave, शूर्पणखाम् Surpanakha, नाम named, विद्युज्जिह्वाय to Vidyujjihva, नामतः by name.

40020323.author: Translation
40020323.content: He gave his Rakshasi sister, named Surpanakha, to Vidyujjihva, who was a lord among the Danavas of the Kalakeya clan.

40020324.author: पदार्थः
40020324.content: अथ then, स्वयं himself, रक्षो the demon (Ravana), दत्त्वा having given, तत् there, मृगयाम् for hunting, अटते स्म wandered, ततः then, राम O Rama, तत्र there, दितेः of Diti, नाम named, मयम् Maya, सुतम् son, अपश्यत् he saw.

40020324.author: Translation
40020324.content: Then, Ravana himself, having given (leave to others), wandered for hunting, and there, O Rama, he saw Maya, the son of Diti.

40020325.author: पदार्थः
40020325.content: कन्यासहायम् accompanied by a maiden, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, अपृच्छत् asked, कः who, भवान् you, एकः alone, निर्मनुष्यमृगे devoid of humans and animals, वने in the forest, अनया with this, मृगशावाक्ष्या fawn-eyed maiden, किमर्थम् for what purpose, सह with, तिष्ठसि you stay.

40020325.author: Translation
40020325.content: Seeing him accompanied by a maiden, Ravana, the night-wanderer, asked, "Who are you, alone in this forest devoid of humans and animals, and for what purpose do you stay with this fawn-eyed maiden?"

40020326.author: पदार्थः
40020326.content: मयः Maya, तथा thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, राम O Rama, पृच्छन्तम् to the one asking, तम् him, निशाचरम् the night-wanderer, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, सर्वम् all, इदम् this, मम my, यथावृत्तम् as it happened, आख्यास्ये I shall narrate.

40020326.author: Translation
40020326.content: O Rama, Maya thus spoke to the inquiring night-wanderer, "Listen, I shall narrate all that has happened concerning me."

40020327.author: पदार्थः
40020327.content: तात O dear one, हेमा Hema, नाम named, अप्सराः an Apsara, यदि if, त्वया by you, श्रुतपूर्वा heard before, सा she, दैवतैः by the gods, मम to me, दत्ता was given, शतक्रतोः to Shakra (Indra), पौलोमी Paulomi, इव like.

40020327.author: Translation
40020327.content: O dear one, if you have heard of an Apsara named Hema before, she was given to me by the gods, just as Paulomi was given to Indra.

40020328.author: पदार्थः
40020328.content: तात O dear one, अहम् I, तस्याम् in her, सक्तमनाः with mind attached, पञ्चवर्षशतानि five hundred years (spent), च and, सा she, दैवतकार्येण for a divine purpose, त्रयोदश thirteen, समाः years, गताः has gone.

40020328.author: Translation
40020328.content: O dear one, I was devoted to her for five hundred years, and she has now been gone for thirteen years for a divine purpose.

40020329.author: पदार्थः
40020329.content: वर्षं year, चतुर्दशं fourteenth, चैव and indeed, ततो then, हेममयं golden, पुरम् city, वज्रवैडूर्यचित्रं adorned with diamonds and lapis lazuli, च and, मायया by illusion, निर्मितं created, मया by me,

40020329.author: Translation
40020329.content: Then, for the fourteenth year, a golden city, adorned with diamonds and lapis lazuli, was created by me through illusion.

40020330.author: पदार्थः
40020330.content: तत्र there, अहम् I, अवसं resided, दीनः miserable, तया by her, हीनः deprived, सुदुःखितः very sorrowful,

40020330.author: Translation
40020330.content: There I resided, miserable, deprived of her, and exceedingly sorrowful.

40020331.author: पदार्थः
40020331.content: तस्मात्पुरात् from that city, दुहितरं daughter, गृहीत्वा having taken, वनम् to the forest, आगतः came, इयम् this, मम my, आत्मजा daughter, राजन् O King, तस्याः her, कुक्षौ in the womb, विवर्धिता grew,

40020331.author: Translation
40020331.content: Having taken my daughter from that city, I came to the forest; this is my daughter, O King, who grew in her womb.

40020332.author: पदार्थः
40020332.content: भर्तारम् husband, अनया with her, सार्धम् together, अस्याः for her, प्राप्तः अस्मि I have come, मार्गितुम् to seek, कन्यापितृत्वं fatherhood of a daughter, दुःखं sorrow, हि indeed, सर्वेषां for all, मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् those desiring honor,

40020332.author: Translation
40020332.content: I have come with her to seek a husband for her, for indeed, the fatherhood of a daughter is a sorrow for all who desire honor.

40020333.author: पदार्थः
40020333.content: कन्या a daughter, हि indeed, द्वे two, कुले families, नित्यं always, संशये in doubt, स्थाप्य having placed, तिष्ठति remains, पुत्रद्वयं two sons, मम my, अपि also, अस्यां in this, भार्यायां wife, सम्बभूव were born, ह indeed,

40020333.author: Translation
40020333.content: Indeed, a daughter always keeps two families in a state of uncertainty; also, two sons were born to me from this wife.

40020334.author: पदार्थः
40020334.content: मायावी Mayavi, प्रथमः the first, तात O dear one, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, तदनन्तरः thereafter. एवम् thus, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been told, याथातथ्येन truthfully, पृच्छतः to one who asks.

40020334.author: Translation
40020334.content: O dear one, Mayavi was the first, and Dundubhi came after him; thus, everything has been truthfully told to you who asked.

40020335.author: पदार्थः
40020335.content: त्वाम् you, इदानीम् now, कथम् how, तात dear one, जानीयाम् shall I know, कः who, भवान् you, इति thus, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु but, तत् that, रक्षः demon, विनीतम् humbly, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020335.author: Translation
40020335.content: "How shall I know you now, dear one, who are you?" When thus spoken to, that demon humbly replied this.

40020336.author: पदार्थः
40020336.content: अहम् I, पौलस्त्यतनयः the son of Pulastya, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, च and, नामतः by name. मुनेः of the sage, विश्रवसः Vishrava, यः who, तु indeed, तृतीयः the third, ब्रह्मणः from Brahma, अभवत् was born.

40020336.author: Translation
40020336.content: "I am the son of Pulastya, named Dashagriva, and I am the son of Sage Vishrava, who was the third (generation) from Brahma."

40020337.author: पदार्थः
40020337.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तदा then, राम O Rama, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the king of demons, दानवः the Danava (Maya), महर्षेः of the great sage, तनयम् the son, ज्ञात्वा having known, मयः Maya, हर्षम् joy, उपागतः attained. दातुम् to give, दुहितरम् his daughter, तस्मै to him, रोचयामास desired, यत्र वै indeed.

40020337.author: Translation
40020337.content: O Rama, when the king of demons spoke thus, Maya, the Danava, felt joy upon knowing him to be the son of the great sage, and indeed desired to give his daughter to him.

40020338.author: पदार्थः
40020338.content: करेण with his hand, तु and, करम् the hand, तस्याः of her (daughter), ग्राहयित्वा having caused to grasp, मयः Maya, तदा then, प्रहसन् laughing, प्राह said, दैत्येन्द्रः the king of Daityas, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the king of Rakshasas, इदम् this, वचः word.

40020338.author: Translation
40020338.content: Then, Maya, the king of Daityas, having made the king of Rakshasas grasp his daughter's hand with his own, laughed and spoke these words to him.

40020339.author: पदार्थः
40020339.content: इयम् this, मम my, आत्मजा daughter, राजन् O King, हेमया by Hema, अप्सरसा Apsara, धृता borne, कन्या maiden, मन्दोदरी Mandodari, नाम named, पत्नी wife, अर्थम् for the purpose of, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let her be accepted.

40020339.author: Translation
40020339.content: O King, this is my daughter, born of the Apsara Hema, named Mandodari; let her be accepted as your wife.

40020340.author: पदार्थः
40020340.content: बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, तम् him, राम O Rama, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, अभ्यभाषत spoke to, प्रज्चाल्य having kindled, तत्र there, च and, एव indeed, अग्निम् fire, अकरोत् he performed, पाणिसङ्ग्रहम् the taking of the hand.

40020340.author: Translation
40020340.content: O Rama, Dashagriva indeed said "Agreed" to him, and having kindled a fire there, he performed the marriage ceremony.

40020341.author: पदार्थः
40020341.content: सः he, हि indeed, तस्य his, मयः Maya, राम O Rama, शाप curse, अभिज्ञः knowing, तपोधनात् from the ascetic, विदित्वा having known, तेन by him, सा she, दत्ता given, तस्य his, पैतामहम् paternal grandfather's, कुलम् lineage.

40020341.author: Translation
40020341.content: O Rama, Maya, indeed knowing of the curse from the ascetic regarding Ravana's paternal grandfather's lineage, gave his daughter to him.

40020342.author: पदार्थः
40020342.content: अमोघाम् unfailing, तस्य to him, शक्तिम् spear, च and, प्रददौ he gave, परम supremely, अद्भुताम् wonderful, परेण by great, तपसा penance, लब्धाम् obtained, जघ्निवाँल् one who struck, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, यया by which.

40020342.author: Translation
40020342.content: And he also gave him the supremely wonderful and unfailing spear, obtained through great penance, by which Lakshmana was struck.

40020343.author: पदार्थः
40020343.content: एवं thus, सीकृतदारो having taken wives, वै indeed, लङ्कायाः of Lanka, ईश्वरः the lord, प्रभुः the mighty one, गत्वा having gone, तु and, नगरीं to the city, भार्ये two wives, भ्रातृभ्यां for his brothers, समुपाहरत् he presented.

40020343.author: Translation
40020343.content: Thus, the mighty lord of Lanka, Ravana, having taken wives for himself, went to the city and presented two wives to his brothers.

40020344.author: पदार्थः
40020344.content: वैरोचनस्य of Virochana, दौहित्रीं the granddaughter, वज्रज्वालेति named Vajrajvala, नामतः by name, तां her, भार्यां as wife, कुम्भकर्णस्य of Kumbhakarna, रावणः Ravana, समकल्पयत् arranged.

40020344.author: Translation
40020344.content: Ravana arranged for Vajrajvala, the granddaughter of Virochana, to be Kumbhakarna's wife.

40020345.author: पदार्थः
40020345.content: गन्धर्वराजस्य of the king of Gandharvas, सुतां the daughter, शैलूषस्य of Shailusha, महात्मनः the great-souled, सरमां Sarama, नाम named, धर्मज्ञां knowing dharma, लेभे obtained, भार्यां as wife, विभीषणः Vibhishana.

40020345.author: Translation
40020345.content: Vibhishana obtained as his wife Sarama, the righteous daughter of the great-souled Gandharva king Shailusha.

40020346.author: पदार्थः
40020346.content: तीरे on the bank, तु indeed, सरसः of the lake, वै truly, तु and, सञ्जज्ञे she was born, मानसस्य of Manasa, हि indeed; सरः the lake, तदा then, मानसं Manasa, तु but, ववृधे grew, जलदागमे at the arrival of clouds.

40020346.author: Translation
40020346.content: She was born on the bank of Lake Manasa, and at that time, during the rainy season, Lake Manasa was overflowing.

40020347.author: पदार्थः
40020347.content: मात्रा by the mother, तु and, तस्याः of that, कन्यायाः girl, स्नेहेन with affection, आक्रन्दितं cried out, वचः words, सरः O lake, मा do not, वर्धयस्व grow, इति thus; ततः from that, सा she, सरमा Sarama, अभवत् became.

40020347.author: Translation
40020347.content: And with affection, the mother of that girl cried out, "O lake, do not grow!", and from that incident, she became known as Sarama.

40020348.author: पदार्थः
40020348.content: एवं thus, ते they, कृतदाराः having taken wives, वै indeed, रेमिरे enjoyed, तत्र there, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, स्वां स्वां their respective, भार्याम् wife, उपागम्य having approached, गन्धर्वाः Gandharvas, इव like, नन्दने in Nandana.

40020348.author: Translation
40020348.content: Thus, having taken wives, those Rakshasas indeed enjoyed themselves there, approaching their respective wives, just like Gandharvas in the Nandana garden.

40020349.author: पदार्थः
40020349.content: ततो then, मन्दोदरी Mandodari, पुत्रं a son, मेघनादम् Meghanada, अजीजनत् gave birth to; सः he, एषः this, इन्द्रजित्नाम named Indrajit, युष्माभिः by you all, अभिधीयते is called.

40020349.author: Translation
40020349.content: Mandodari then gave birth to a son named Meghanada, who is known to you all as Indrajit.

40020350.author: पदार्थः
40020350.content: जातमात्रेण immediately after birth, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, तेन by him, रावणसूनुना by Ravana's son, रुदता while crying, सुमहान् a very great, मुक्तः was emitted, नादः sound/roar, जलधरोपमः like a thundercloud.

40020350.author: Translation
40020350.content: Indeed, immediately after his birth, Ravana's son, while crying, emitted a tremendous roar resembling a thundercloud.

40020351.author: पदार्थः
40020351.content: जडीकृता was stunned, च and, सा that, लङ्का Lanka, तस्य his, नादेन by the sound/roar, राघव O Raghava; पिता father, तस्य his, अकरोत् made/gave, नाम name, मेघनाद Meghanada, इति thus, स्वयम् himself.

40020351.author: Translation
40020351.content: O Raghava, that Lanka was stunned by his roar, and his father himself named him Meghanada.

40020352.author: पदार्थः
40020352.content: सः he, अवर्धत grew up, तदा then, राम O Rama, रावणान्तःपुरे in Ravana's inner palace, शुभे auspicious/beautiful, रक्ष्यमाणः being protected, वरस्त्रीभिः by excellent women, छन्नः covered/hidden, काष्ठैः by wood, इव like, अनलः fire.

40020352.author: Translation
40020352.content: O Rama, he then grew up in Ravana's beautiful inner palace, protected by excellent women, like a fire hidden by wood.

40020353.author: पदार्थः
40020353.content: मातापित्रोः of his mother and father, महाहर्षं great joy, जनयन् causing/generating, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son.

40020353.author: Translation
40020353.content: Ravana's son was causing great joy to his mother and father. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वादशः सर्गः ।। 12 ।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
